purpose: Bounded native chapel geometry refinement; no 2D edition changes and no new generated images.

generator.method: Runtime ArrayMesh construction from dimensioned native stone/wood/roof solids, pointed arch paths and actual wall apertures. No facade billboard or viewport texture.

source_derivations: Existing shared generated material quadrants and exact source-glass extraction are unchanged; see materials.json and chapel-glass.json for prompts/references/source quadrilateral. No new texture, image repaint, pixel repair or per-side material colour override.
changes: Deeper 10-plank closed oak door and attached metal straps/rivets; three existing pointed stone arch orders plus two jamb shafts and capitals.
Both gables contain real circular masonry holes with recessed glass, four lobe rings and radial tracery.
Four side lancets have measured stepped stone surrounds; rear gains one consistent lancet clear of the tower.
Front/rear corner pilasters remain inside the existing plinth band.
Twelve restrained slate rows per roof slope with thin physical course lips, stone coping and shared existing slate material.
Visible landing top now meets existing native floor/ramp height; no physics, placement or gameplay-rule changes.

budget.exception_to_general_house_budget: This landmark includes a full bell tower/spire, genuinely cut arch/oculus walls, paired lancet tracery and all four sides; repeated pieces merge by shared material. Small side roses and linear cylinders use lower tessellation than main gable detail.

checks: All generated vertex/UV coordinates finite; normals unit length; front/back winding consistent.
Actual triangle rays pass through doorway, both pane centres of every side/rear lancet and clear regions of front/rear oculus masonry.
Actual oak triangle ray measures closed door recess 0.28m.
Actual stone triangle ray measures landing top 0.28m.
Source reference, generated original glass and extracted runtime glass hashes remain exact.
verification.visual_review: Pending actual portrait/landscape browser review; headless results do not establish reference fidelity or user approval.

limitations: Closed building; door recess and window holes do not imply a walkable interior.
Existing native rectangular footprint collision and platform/ramp are unchanged; decorative roof/tower geometry does not introduce a detailed collision mesh.
Shared generated albedo is not a measured PBR scan. Small detail readability still needs the actual fixed-camera mobile review.
